function isStr(v: unknown): v is string {
  return typeof v === "string";
}

function viaEquals(x: number | string): string {
  const isText = typeof x === "string";
  if (isText === true) return x.toUpperCase();
  return x.toFixed(1);
}

function viaLiteralFirst(x: number | string): string {
  const isText = typeof x === "string";
  if (false === isText) return x.toFixed(1);
  return x.toUpperCase();
}

function viaNotEquals(x: number | string): string {
  const isText = typeof x === "string";
  if (isText !== true) return x.toFixed(1);
  return x.toUpperCase();
}

function viaLooseEquals(x: number | string): string {
  const isText = typeof x === "string";
  if (isText == true) return x.toUpperCase();
  return x.toFixed(1);
}

function viaNestedAlias(x: number | string): string {
  const isText = typeof x === "string";
  const ok = isText === true;
  if (ok) return x.toUpperCase();
  return x.toFixed(1);
}

function viaPredicate(x: number | string): string {
  if (isStr(x) === false) return x.toFixed(1);
  return x.toUpperCase();
}

function comparedItself(x: boolean | string): string {
  if (x !== true) {
    const rest: false | string = x;
    return `rest ${rest}`;
  }
  return "true";
}

for (const value of ["abc", 2.5]) {
  console.log(
    viaEquals(value),
    viaLiteralFirst(value),
    viaNotEquals(value),
    viaLooseEquals(value),
    viaNestedAlias(value),
    viaPredicate(value)
  );
}
console.log(comparedItself(true), comparedItself(false), comparedItself("s"));
